name: Hotel Splendide Royal Lugano
positioning: Historic Belle Epoque palace hotel directly on Lake Lugano, a short distance from the city centre, with a spa and the Michelin-starred restaurant I Due Sud
best_for: Couples and families wanting a lakefront base close to central Lugano
Families or small groups who want a suite for up to four guests
Food lovers interested in Michelin-starred dining

facts.text: The hotel sits directly on Lake Ceresio, also called Lake Lugano.
The hotel is a short distance from Lugano's city centre.
The city centre, boutiques, cultural sites and main attractions are a few minutes away.
The room types are meant to suit couples, family holidays or business stays.
The hotel belongs to The Leading Hotels of the World, Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Virtuoso and Swiss Historic Hotels.
The spa has an outdoor terrace looking out over the lake.
The hotel's restaurants are La Veranda and I Due Sud.
The hotel serves a traditional English tea.
On summer evenings, pizza is served on the terrace.
The hotel offers a candlelit gourmet dinner.
The hotel has bars, terraces and event spaces.

highlights.text: The hotel is a historic Belle Epoque palace that first opened as a hotel in 1887.
I Due Sud holds one star in the Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026.
The Splendide Lifestyle Spa has a panoramic pool, a sauna, a Turkish bath, a gym and treatments.
Lake Ceresio and the mountains around Lugano can be seen from the panoramic rooms, the terraces and many public areas.
The suites measure roughly 60 to 85 square metres and can sleep up to four guests.

considerations.text: Not every room faces the lake: rooms and suites have either a lake view or a park view, so ask for a lake view when booking.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the central location.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
